name: band-coach
description: Adaptive music-instrument coach that runs from a single HTML file

scripts.test:all: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=$(node tests/helpers/browser.mjs) "tests/*.test.mjs" "tests/build/*.test.mjs" "tests/characterization/*.test.mjs" "tests/unit/*.test.mjs" "tests/unit/notation/*.test.mjs" && npm run test:release
scripts.coverage: node tests/unit/coverage-floor.mjs --prepare coverage && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="src/core/**" --test-coverage-include="src/song/**" --test-coverage-include="src/audio/**" --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info "tests/unit/*.test.mjs" "tests/unit/notation/*.test.mjs" && node tests/unit/coverage-floor.mjs coverage/lcov.info
